name: Amitar Internet Services
summary: Kelmscott/Armadale (Perth) WA dialup + hosting + web-design ISP; live from 1998, site frozen as a static page from ~2008 through 2017, domain reused by 2023.

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture 12 Feb 1998 (amitar.com.au); Usenet active Jun-Sep 1998; 'Amitar Internet Services, based in Kelmscott Western Australia provides Internet Dial-up, hosting and Web Design Services' for the Armadale/Kelmscott area.
source: https://web.archive.org/web/19980212045003/http://www.amitar.com.au/ (earliest of the amitar.com.au Wayback captures per CDX)
https://web.archive.org/web/20080827220315id_/http://www.amitar.com.au/ (meta description: dialup + hosting + web design, Kelmscott/Armadale WA)

events.details: Still presenting as an active 'Amitar Internet Services' dialup + hosting + web-design site in Aug 2008; that page then persisted byte-identical through Feb 2017 (business apparently wound down but the site was left up), and the domain shows unrelated content by 2023.
source: https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=amitar.com.au&output=json (identical page digest XNSJDYWDSHYFECQEUNHYBJKBEONMIP7A across 2008-08-27, 2009, 2011, 2015, 2017; different content 2023-11-04)
